mapper.insert: insert into adstatusofuser(USERUNIQUE, PERIOD, FINISHADFLAG, FINISHORDERFLAG, CHOOSEORDERFLAG) values (#{userUnique},#{period},#{finishAdvertiseFlag},#{finishOrderFlag},#{chooseOrderFlag}) on duplicate key update FINISHADFLAG = #{finishAdvertiseFlag}, FINISHORDERFLAG = #{finishOrderFlag}, CHOOSEORDERFLAG = #{chooseOrderFlag}
mapper.update: update adstatusofuser set FINISHADFLAG=#{finishFlag} where USERUNIQUE=#{userUnique} and PERIOD=#{currentPeriod}
mapper.select: select FINISHADFLAG from adstatusofuser where USERUNIQUE=#{userUnique} and PERIOD=#{currentPeriod}
select USERUNIQUE,PERIOD,FINISHADFLAG as finishAdvertiseFlag,FINISHORDERFLAG,CHOOSEORDERFLAG from adstatusofuser where USERUNIQUE=#{userUnique} and PERIOD=#{period}
select CHOOSEORDERFLAG from adstatusofuser where USERUNIQUE=#{userUnique} and PERIOD=#{currentPeriod}
select FINISHORDERFLAG from adstatusofuser where USERUNIQUE=#{userUnique} and PERIOD=#{currentPeriod}
select FINISHORDERFLAG from adstatusofuser where USERUNIQUE=#{userUnique} and PERIOD=(select max(PERIOD) from adofuser where USERUNIQUE=#{userUnique})
mapper.update: update adstatusofuser set FINISHORDERFLAG=#{finishFlag} where USERUNIQUE=#{userUnique} and PERIOD=#{period}
